description:
Market-implied future rental price for one GPU family (USD per GPU-hour), from
        prediction markets (Kalshi, Polymarket) and ICE futures, plus today's compute-index
        benchmarks and cheap-gpus.com's own current median price. Covers H100, H200, B200,
        A100, RTX 5090 and RTX PRO 6000.
